title: Love Swimming

services.name: Group Lessons »
services.desc: We encourage all of our swimmers to begin with group classes because of the benefits of learning in the social atmosphere of a group. We find that most students are highly motivated in this setting, and that they have a lot of fun too! Some swimmers require more individual attention, however for these swimmers we offer private and semi-private classes. Within our private classes, swimmers work one-on-one with an instructor for a full half-hour class. Privates are available for anyone over the age of 3. We also offer Semi-Private lessons where a maximum of 2 swimmers work with one instructor. Space for private and semi-private lessons is limited. Please consult with our general manager to

blurb: All students who are under the age of 3 and/or not potty-trained must wear a swim diaper and a swim diaper cover over it. Our definition of potty-trained is: Being conscious of their need to go to the restroom. Also, being comfortable vocalizing their need to go to the restroom (to an adult other than their parents) without being prompted. The swim diaper cover must have elastic bands around the thighs and abdomen.
